items.description: In a surprising discovery, a family in London uncovered a mounted thylacine head tucked away in a box under their bed. items.title: Scientists find Serbian mineral almost identical to Superman's kryptonite
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Scientists discovered a rare white mineral called Jadarite in Serbia in 2004, later finding that its chemical composition closely matched Superman's fictional Kryptonite. Unlike the glowing green substance, Jadarite is neither green nor radioactive. New research suggests the mineral could supply a significant portion of Europe's lithium needs for electric vehicles, although local opposition has prevented mining operations.

items.title: Canada tests noisy drones as hundreds of polar bears prepare to gather

items.description: As hundreds of polar bears gather near Churchill in Canada, conservationists are testing noisy drones to move them away from populated areas. The measures aim to protect people and animals as climate change delays sea ice formation, increasing the risk of encounters.

items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: An Indiana father who lost his $350,000-a-year job after 26 years and moved to Virginia for work has lost his appeal in a custody dispute. items.description: बढ़ते हवाई किराए को लेकर सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने एक जनहित याचिका (PIL) पर सुनवाई करने से इनकार कर दिया। याचिकाकर्ता के 700% तक किराया बढ़ने के दावे पर कोर्ट ने कहा, 'आप हवाई यात्रा मत करिए। आगे बढ़िए।' जस्टिस जे. विक्रम नाथ की बेंच के सामने वकील ने दलील दी कि विमान का किराया 700% तक बढ़ गया है। उन्होंने कहा कि हवाई यात्रा जरूरी सेवा है और किराए में इतनी ज्यादा बढ़ोतरी संविधान के अनुच्छेद 14 का उल्लंघन है। हालांकि, कोर्ट ने इन दलीलों पर सुनवाई नहीं की और याचिका खारिज कर दी। एयरलाइंस को सरकार से परमिशन…
